meta.name: outbound-campaign-architect
meta.description: Designs high-performance outbound sequences based on ICP, available channels, and empirical lemlist data from hundreds of thousands of campaigns. Use this skill whenever the user wants to build, design, or optimize an outbound sequence, campaign, or cadence — whether they say "create a sequence", "build a campaign", "what steps should I use", "how should I structure my outreach", or "help me reach out to X". Also trigger when the user mentions an ICP + a goal (e.g. "I want to book meetings with VP Sales at Series B SaaS"). Always use this skill before any sequence is written.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计高效的外呼序列，提升客户触达转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计或优化销售外呼流程
copy.tagline_en: Design high-performance outbound sequences to boost outreach conversion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design or optimize sales outbound sequences

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会像外联策略专家，先询问目标客户、产品卖点、可用渠道等信息，然后基于lemlist大数据设计最优的外联步骤、渠道顺序和条件逻辑，最后输出可视化行动计划。它不写邮件正文，只规划结构。
howto.when: 当你说“创建外联序列”“设计推广活动”“帮我优化流程”等，或提到目标客户群+具体目标时，Claude自动接管，先收集信息再设计。

say.text: 帮我设计一套针对SaaS公司销售副总裁的冷外联序列。
say.note: Claude会询问目标客户细节并给出步骤规划。

say.text: 我的目标客户是制造业CEO，10个联系人，怎么安排步骤？
say.note: Claude会基于数据推荐短序列和渠道。

say.text: 优化我现有的LinkedIn和邮件组合外联，回复率低。
say.note: Claude会分析当前结构并给出改进建议。
